3072.name: Withered Cocoon
desc: The withered cocoon of a wamoura.

3073.name: Eruca Egg
desc: The oversized egg of an eruca.

3074.name: Blanched Silver
desc: A small lump of silver that has lost some of its lustre.

3075.name: Undying Ooze
desc: This repulsive gunk continues to bubble and squirm long after being separated from the doomed that excreted it.

3076.name: Bone Chips
desc: Cracked and chipped bones of various size, shape, and origin.

3077.name: Wailing Rags
desc: When you rest your ear on these tattered garments, you can hear a tortured scream in the distance�E

3078.name: Cracked Drgscale.
desc: A massive force must have been required to cause this sturdy scale of a dragon to crack.

3079.name: Gory Pincer
desc: This scorpion pincer is caked with the blood of its prey.

3080.name: Ext. Eyestalk
desc: The fully extended eyestalk of a slug, doomed never to return to its retracted state.

3081.name: Coeurl Round
desc: This round cut of thigh meat from a coeurl is laced with fat and gristle.

3082.name: Withered Bud
desc: Separated from the mandragora it sprouted from, it looks about to crumble into dust at any moment.

3083.name: Mngl. Ck. Skin
desc: The cockatrice this skin was taken from clearly did not go down without a fight�E

3084.name: Great Root
desc: The thick root of an ancient treant.

3085.name: Bewitching Tusk
desc: The ensorcelled tusk of a bugard.

3086.name: Molt Scraps
desc: Scraps from the shedded molt of a lizard.

3087.name: Apkallu Down
desc: These underfeathers of an apkallu are soft and warm to the touch.

3088.name: Avian Remex
desc: A large feather that allows birds to control their flight path in strong wind.

3089.name: Orbn. Cheekmeat
desc: The rare cheekmeat of an orobon, considered a delicacy.

3090.name: Spheroid Plate
desc: A plate of some indeterminate metal, retrieved from a deactivated spheroid.

3091.name: Hd. Raptor Skin
desc: The frozen, hardened skin of a raptor.

3092.name: Mocking Beak
desc: The beak of a colibri said to have the ability to mimic adventurers' voices.

3093.name: H.Q. Crab Meat
desc: This piece of land crab meat is of perfect quality. So perfect, in fact, that it would be unthinkable to eat it.

3094.name: H.Q. Rock Salt
desc: A chunk of rock salt of the highest grade and quality.

3095.name: Worm-Eaten Bud
desc: This hole-ridden mandragora bud has clearly served as a feast for many a famished worm.

3096.name: Spotted Flyfrond
desc: An attractive spotted pattern adorns this giant flytrap leaf.

3097.name: Blk. Rabbit Tail
desc: The tail of a black rabbit, said to serve as a warding talisman.

3098.name: Gnr. Taurus Horn
desc: The balefully gnarled horn of a taurus.

3099.name: Gargouille Stone
desc: A hunk of flesh from a gargouille that has hardened to the point that it is indistinguishable from actual stone.

3100.name: Moonbeam Clam
desc: A rare clam said to open its shell only when the light of the moon shines upon it.

3101.name: Dented Skull
desc: The skull of a corpselight that seems to have caught a hefty blow to its head.

3102.name: Stiff. Tentacle
desc: This tentacle has stiffened after the death of the soulflayer it was once attached to.

3103.name: Black Whisker
desc: Other than its jet-black color, this feline whisker is entirely unremarkable.

3104.name: Opaque Wing
desc: The murky-colored wing of some unnatural beast.

3105.name: Fortune Wing
desc: This red wing of a ladybug is said to bring good luck to he who finds it.

3106.name: Djinn Ashes
desc: The smoldering ashes of a now-extinguished djinn.

3107.name: Shockshroom
desc: A poisonous mushroom said to send a paralyzing shock through the body if consumed.

3108.name: Crwl. Floatstone
desc: A small stone removed from the stomach of a crawler. Can be used as pumice.

3109.name: H.Q. Rabbit Hide
desc: The particularly sturdy hide of a rabbit.

3110.name: Rvg. Seal: Hd.
desc: A musty slip of parchment, worn and faded with the years. Faintly visible is the image of a piece of armor, annotated with elaborately scribed glyphs of a long-lost tongue.

3210.name: Vision Stone
desc: A peculiar translucent stone that refracts light, making objects seen through it appear bright and clear.

3211.name: Vision Coin
desc: A palm-sized coin of a curious transparent metal.

3212.name: Vision Jewel
desc: A shimmering jewel of perfect cut and clarity.

3213.name: Vision Card
desc: A timeworn card bearing an exquisitely illustrated depiction of a far-seeing eye.

3214.name: Ardor Stone
desc: Holding this small crimson stone in your hand, you feel a gentle warmth well up from within you.

3215.name: Ardor Coin
desc: A palm-sized coin embossed with the mark of a burning heart.

3216.name: Ardor Jewel
desc: The red hues of this jewel blaze and surge like the flames of passion.

3217.name: Ardor Card
desc: A timeworn card bearing an exquisite illustration of a raging flame.

3218.name: Wieldance Stone
desc: Taking this stone into hand, you can feel your arm move more freely.

3219.name: Wieldance Coin
desc: A palm-sized coin emblazoned with the mark of a hand gripping a blade.

3220.name: Wieldance Jewel
desc: The amber hues of this jewel swish and swirl unconstrained.

3221.name: Wieldance Card
desc: A timeworn card bearing an exquisite illustration of a whirling sword.

3222.name: Balance Stone
desc: A sturdy stone that, when placed on the ground, can curiously not be moved from either side.

3223.name: Balance Coin
desc: A peculiar coin that, when flipped, will always alternate heads and tails.

3224.name: Balance Jewel
desc: A beautiful translucent jewel of perfectly symmetrical cut.

3225.name: Balance Card
desc: A timeworn card bearing an exquisitely illustrated depiction of a weighing scale.

3226.name: Voyage Stone
desc: Taking this stone into hand, you can feel the wind blowing at your back.

3227.name: Voyage Coin
desc: A palm-sized coin embossed with the mark of a ship with billowing sails.

3228.name: Voyage Jewel
desc: The blue hues of this jewel ebb and flow like the ocean tides.

3229.name: Voyage Card
desc: A timeworn card bearing an exquisitely illustrated depiction of a striding man.

3230.name: Tablilla Mercury
desc: A shimmering liquid metal extracted from the doll Tablilla.

3231.name: Sharabha Hide
desc: The rugged hide of the manticore Sharabha.

3232.name: Tiger King Hide
desc: The regally colored hide of the fell tiger Ansherekh.

3233.name: Vadleany Fluid
desc: A pungent liquid extracted from a slain vadleany, its role of driving away would-be foes unfulfilled.

3234.name: Oasis Water
desc: A precious bottle of pure water from a desert oasis, carried by the fearsome Bugul Noz.

3235.name: Sandy Shard
desc: Desert sand clings to the surface of this shattered doll fragment.

3236.name: Smoldering Arm
desc: This arm of a bomb still steams and smolders despite having been long since severed from its master.

3237.name: Sand-caked Fang
desc: This oversized manticore fang is caked with such a thick layer of sand that its original shape and color is impossible to discern.

3238.name: H.Q. Dhalmel Hide
desc: A particularly durable dhalmel hide.

3239.name: Puppet's Blood
desc: The blood of an unnaturally bred puk, said to impel anyone who drinks it to dance uncontrollably.

3240.name: H.Q. Cktrice. Skin
desc: A particularly durable cockatrice skin.

3241.name: Ladybird Leaf
desc: A broad, thick-veined leaf that had been stuck to the back of an unaware ladybug.

3242.name: H.Q. Scorpn. Claw
desc: A particularly sharp scorpion claw.

3243.name: Sabulous Clay
desc: A variety of desert clay with a high sand content.

3244.name: Giant Mistletoe
desc: A parasitic plant so tenacious that it is known to strangle the life out of even the mightiest oaks.

3245.name: Bevel Gear
desc: A massive, jagged-toothed gear of bronze that powered the mighty Koghatu.

3246.name: Snow God Core
desc: This condensed soul of the fearsome Upas-Kamuy burns with a chill blue flame.

3247.name: Sisyphus Fragment
desc: A fragment of debris claimed off the shattered body of the golem Sisyphus.

3248.name: Rimed Wing
desc: The frost-covered wing of the notorious imp Chillwing Hwitti.

3249.name: Audumbla Hide
desc: The rough hide of the bovine audumbla.

3250.name: Helical Gear
desc: A curved metallic gear that once powered a mighty acrolith.

3251.name: Gear Fluid
desc: A peculiar, oil-like substance that will not freeze in even the coldest temperatures.

3252.name: Gelid Arm
desc: The arm of a snoll, so stingingly cold that holding it in one's bare hand will inflict an almost instant case of frostbite.

3253.name: H.Q. Marid Hide
desc: A particularly durable marid hide.

3254.name: Ice Wyvern Scale
desc: This wyvern scale is as chill as ice to the touch.

3255.name: Whiteworm Clay
desc: A rich clay-like substance excreted from the body of an entozoon.

3256.name: Imp Sentry's Horn
desc: A compact horn employed by imp sentries to warn their masters of potential interlopers.

3257.name: Benumbed Eye
desc: This clouded eye of a benumbed vodoriga stares at you with a soulless, empty gaze.

3258.name: H.Q. Buffalo Horn
desc: A particularly large and sturdy buffalo horn.

3259.name: H.Q. B. Tiger Hide
desc: The particularly rugged and sleek hide of a black tiger.

3260.name: Teekess. Fragment
desc: The shattered fragment of the Teekesselchen.

3261.name: Minaruja Skull
desc: The abnormally hard skull of the wyvern Minaruja.

3262.name: Jaculus Wing
desc: The almost-weightless yet highly durable wing of the peapuk Jaculus.

3263.name: Naiad's Lock
desc: A wispy lock of hair from the pixie Lorelei, whose haunting song is said to have beckoned many an adventurer to an untimely demise.

3264.name: Goblin Gunpowder
desc: A highly explosive gunpowder devised by the mad Goblin bombardier Burstrox Powderpate.

3265.name: Bubbling Oil
desc: Extracted from a magic pot, the noxious fumes of this thick oil induce nausea with a single whiff.

3266.name: Darkflame Arm
desc: Severed from an unfortunate djinn, this arm blazes with a black, heatless flame.

3267.name: Pursuer's Wing
desc: The wing of the ajattara wyvern, said to chase away evil spirits of the forest.

3268.name: H.Q. Wivre Hide
desc: The particularly thick and durable skin of a wivre.

3269.name: Decaying Molar
desc: Eaten away from within by hungry grubs, this molar of a skeleton smells even worse than it looks.

3270.name: H.Q. Pugil Scale
desc: This large pugil scale shimmers brilliantly under light.

3271.name: Fay Teardrop

3272.name: Unseelie Eye

3273.name: Goblin Rope
desc: An unsightly but sturdy rope of Goblin make.

3274.name: Goblin Oil
desc: This malodorous oil is employed by Goblins to prevent their armor from rusting any more than it already has.

3275.name: Genbu Scrap

3288.name: Dragua's Scale

3289.name: Apademak Horn

3290.name: Isgebind's Heart

3291.name: Alfard's Fang
desc: The massive fang of Alfard drips with lethal poison.

3292.name: Azdaja's Horn
desc: The horrifically twisted horn of Azdaja, embodiment of hatred and destruction.

3293.name: Iron Plate
desc: A piece wrenched from the plate armor of an iron giant.

3294.name: Colorless Soul
desc: This elemental soul, drained of all its power, has faded to a milky white.

3295.name: Incrscnt. Shade
desc: This faded wisp is all that remains of a wandering soul lost in Abyssea. It glows wistfully with the arrival of dusk.

3296.name: Decrscnt. Shade
desc: This faded wisp is all that remains of a wandering soul lost in Abyssea. It glows mournfully with the break of dawn.
